description.description: What the project does; shown in the editor

defaultEnvironment.description: Environment used when a run names none, e.g. dev; the name of a file in environments/

variables.description: Variables for all environments, used as ${NAME}; an environment can override them. Values may use other variables, e.g. ${BASE}\inbox

secretStore.description: Where ${secret:NAME} reads secrets from, unless an environment sets its own: env (environment variables) or inline (secrets: in the file, plain text); empty: the local secret store, which is not available yet

secrets.description: Secrets in plain text for secretStore: inline, used as ${secret:NAME} where no environment has its own; only for development and simple APIs

settings.description: Defaults and limits for the runs of the project

defaultJoin.description: When an action with several incoming links starts, if it sets no join: all (every link decided), first or each

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Most runs of the project at the same time on the server; a start beyond it is rejected. 0: no limit

history.description: Run history of the project: which runs are kept

keepDays.description: Days ended runs are kept in the run history; older ones are removed

maxRuns.description: Most runs kept in the run history of the project; the oldest beyond it are removed

cli.description: Which ended runs of runnel run are kept in the run history: all, errors (only failed ones) or none; runnel run --history overrides it

onError.description: Workflow started when a run of the project fails (not for runs in the editor), relative to the project; it gets the FAILED_… parameters it declares. A workflow or pipeline can set its own or none
